motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Subtle scroll entrance with reduced-motion support.

components.name: Outlined link
components.description: Primary link to the project list.
components.css: .ds-outline { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:62px; padding:0 28px; border:1px solid #6878bd; border-radius:10px; color:#e0e8ff; text-decoration:none; } .ds-outline:hover { background:#181d30; border-color:#a2b0ef; } .ds-outline:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #a6b6ff; outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Fixed navigation for the single-page portfolio.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:32px; padding:24px; background:rgba(9,10,15,.8); } .ds-nav a { color:#b8bac7; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color:#fff; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #a6b6ff; outline-offset:5px; }

narrative.overview: The portfolio uses a dark continuous canvas, centered introduction, and readable project descriptions. Movement supports the reading sequence without overwhelming the content.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black background with restrained cool accents.
Clear sans-serif typography and generous vertical spacing.
A small portrait and sparse connection lines.
Lists and timelines instead of cards or overlays.
dos: Do keep content visible and legible when motion is reduced.
Do use scroll motion to support the reading sequence.
donts: Don't surround the portrait with decorative effects.
Don't turn project lists into grids of cards or modal overlays.
